intent: Create a high-quality adult costume fitting photograph that precisely expresses a plunging V neckline, natural body proportions and believable garment support. One original 32-year-old female court negotiator stands in a neutral fitting pose.

subjects.description: Original 32-year-old adult woman with naturally proportionate curves, a medium-full bust, clear realistic waist and softly rounded hips. Calm confident expression; dark hair in a simple low coiled updo, natural brown eyes and rose-toned makeup.
appearance: A floor-length jade silk-satin formal dress with a fitted bodice. Two opaque front panels form a clearly visible deep V-shaped neckline from the inner shoulders to the lower end of the sternum. The abdomen is covered by the solid lower bodice and waist band.

The side bodice panels securely cover and support the breasts from front and three-quarter views. Shaped darts, inner support and shoulder attachments maintain the natural contour. Neatly faced V edges lie flat and join the solid bodice below the neckline.

A fine low-contrast woven flowing-line pattern is integrated into the jade main cloth. The long skirt is fully opaque. Small aged-silver fasteners sit at the waist junctions; there is no transparent insert filling the V opening.
subjects.action: Stands with relaxed shoulders and arms slightly separated from the torso, allowing the complete neckline and waist construction to remain visible.

scene.summary: Neutral warm-gray studio with soft side-front light and gentle fill; knee-up near-frontal three-quarter view, camera at chest height with a normal portrait perspective. Garment opening, material, face and body proportions are readable together. Real cloth weight, natural skin and clean sharp material detail; restrained adult fashion styling.

must_preserve: Clearly visible deep V ending at the lower sternum, covered abdomen, opaque bust panels and natural body proportions.
